title.narrative: Capacity Development and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities in Somalia

description.narrative: (4) Workshop with strategic groups in Somalia. (1) Report including all advocacy efforts for the National Disability Law in Somalia. Equipping (2) training centers for the deaf: (1) in Mogadishu and (1) in Hargeisa. Training (10) sign language trainers (5 in Somalia and 5 in Somaliland) 25 students benefited from sign language training courses in Somaliland. Developing (1) sign language curriculum. Identifying (50) community influencers in the field of disability rights in Somalia. Improving community members’ awareness of disability rights. Establishing (1) hotline to provide legal advice via phone in Somalia. 3) Centers in Somalia equipped to provide necessary protection services to survivors of gender-based violence. (150) women and girls benefited from psychosocial support, health and legal services. (20) Beneficiaries of formal justice providers from training activities. Providing (1000) wheelchairs, (600) white sticks and (600) crutches to people with disabilities.

Strengthening the capacities of relevant agencies and institutions to support persons with disabilities - Advocating for the rights of persons with disabilities - Providing virtual counselling and information services - Protecting women and girls from sexual and gender-based violence - Providing mobility aids to persons with disabilities

The project aims to improve the quality of life of persons with disabilities through: 1- Advocating for changes in national policy frameworks and systems to address stigma and discrimination in society. 2- Building the capacity of government agencies concerned with disability and providing technical and operational support. 3- Empowering persons with disabilities and their families, especially women and girls, to improve their access to legal and social services.
